description: This file defines a worker service (`EventReminderWorkerService`) that periodically checks for upcoming leaves and sends notifications to the user, acting as part of an Android app's notification system for leave reminders.

classes.name: EventReminderWorkerService
classes.description: A worker class extending CoroutineWorker, responsible for checking upcoming leaves and posting notifications.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Performs background work to check for upcoming leaves and creates notifications accordingly.

methods.name: createNotificationChannel
methods.description: Creates a notification channel for displaying notifications on Android O and above.
